verdict.rationale: Porkbun's API exposes full CRUD read access to DNS records and domain data, supports transfer-out of domains, and even documents moving DNS zones to a customer's own Cloudflare account — all of which let a user extract their data and leave for another provider. However, there is no dedicated 'export all my data' feature or bulk open-format export/download tool; a user must script the extraction themselves via API calls. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/one-click data export feature, an explicit open-format (e.g., zone file, JSON dump) export tool, and independent/hands-on confirmation that a full account export-and-leave workflow works as described.
